text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back to the academy with Sakura Bakushin O…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Did you know? My rival is here right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, I start to think it must be an Umamusume of the same generation, but…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Did you get it yet? Yes, my rival is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The speed king of the ocean! The sailfish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The ruler of the land is me. But the current ruler of the ocean… is that fish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I plan to take that title for myself and be named the fastest on both land and sea!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I need to master speed to be the strongest Umamusume and the greatest model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna pay a visit to the aquarium's special exhibit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: HERE I AM!
choice_data_list: Don't make too much noise inside.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry! Even a class representative like me can't help but get excited sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's lock on to the enemy's position! Where could it be? …AH-HA!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's a school of sardines! Did you know eating sardines can increase thinking power?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ever since hearing that, I started eating the entire fish from head to tail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's made my mind as sharp as a knife. Even the great sailfish would tremble in fear.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ohh, look over there! That thing moving in the water!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's an amberjack! A fish often associated with success! Lemme read the plaque. Apparently they sometimes call them "Mejiro" when they're still small!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So then, do you think McQueen will eventually become Amberjack McQueen?
choice_data_list: Remember, we're here for the sailfish!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right! I just couldn't ignore such a fine specimen! I was careless!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My senses tell me it's around here somewhere! Hmm, the fish in the neighboring tank is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A sailfish…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …Mnph! Hnnngh!
choice_data_list: (She's excited but still trying to stay quiet!)
(She's excited but still trying to stay quiet!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… So that's a sailfish. It somewhat resembles me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's so sleek-looking, even that look in its eyes… it is speed fish-ified…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I want to challenge it! But I can't just go about breaking the aquarium rules…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uggh! What should I dooo?!
choice_data_list: Let's just stick to observing today.
How about simulating a race in your head?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see… One must know their rival and prepare for when the day comes, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No problem! It's time for those sardines I ate to prove their worth! I will discover the secret to that speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Did you see that just now?! The dorsal fin went swoosh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I see! I totally penetrated the hidden depths of its secret abilities!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In other words, the trick is… to make your dorsal fin go swoosh with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! This is the result of my sardine diet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For someone with no dorsal fin, I'm not sure how that will be useful… But she looks happy, so I decide to keep my mouth shut.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Simulate a race in my mind? As a genius, the very thought of it makes my heart pound!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Just… got to… race… in… my mind…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you… Sailfish!

text_block_list.name: Sailfish
text_block_list.text: Hm, so you're the fastest Umamusume on land? Do you think you can compete against my god-like speed and stamina?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's MY line! Prepare to have your neck… erm, dorsal fin… wrung out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It was a true battle of speed and stamina! It was enough to make me want to change my name to Mejiro Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nobody will ever know what went down inside her mind, but it seems to have given her some insight.
